Chapter 1093: 22: Stepping Into Domination (Subscription Requested)_3

Chapter 1093: Chapter 22: Stepping Into Domination (Subscription Requested)_3

“The taste is quite good.”

Lin Yuan carefully savored a sip and praised it.

In terms of enhancing the body and soul, the wine brewed by the Xuanyuan Supreme is usually akin to that in the Chaos Void, where the effects of those heavenly wines and spiritual wines are extraordinarily numerous.

However, the taste was truly unique.

“Hahaha, too bad Guli, Void God, they can’t taste such fine wine anymore.” The Supreme Xia Qin also enjoyed a sip cheerfully.

The Ancient Power Supreme Being, Void God Ultimate Being, had voluntarily ‘dispersed the Dao’ a thousand years ago to cultivate the Martial Tao path given by Lin Yuan.

Before they recover to the Twelve-Star level, it’s likely that all their focus would be on cultivation, with no interest in tasting fine wine.

This lack of interest was not due to sensing any danger, but rather from the fact that their original strength was at the Twelve-Star level. Their strength fell after ‘dispersing the Dao’, creating a sense of disparity, so they wouldn’t want to appear before other supreme beings.

“Void God, Guli, they are probably about to emerge from seclusion.”

As the master of the ‘Shard World’ of the Star Tear, Lin Yuan was able to understand the cultivation progress of the two supreme beings after ‘dispersing the Dao’ with just a thought.

Over a thousand years, the two supreme beings had re-cultivated to the tenth rank. Since it was a re-cultivation, there is no talk of a final leap; once they reach the Eleventh Rank Peak, they can directly enter the Twelfth-Star level.

The Ancient Power Supreme Being, Void God Ultimate Being were able to cultivate so quickly primarily because they were re-cultivating in the Path Splitting Realm. The stages like the First, Second, and Third Layers naturally couldn’t stop them.

Additionally, because the Martial Tao path they followed was specifically perfected by Lin Yuan for them. Although the dedication involved wasn’t comparable to the evolution path given to his parents, it was entirely sufficient for the two supreme beings.

“Are they about to emerge from seclusion?”

Hearing this, the Xuanyuan Xia Qin Supreme Being felt a surge of anticipation.

With Guli and Void God returning to the Twelve-Star level, it meant that among the remaining supreme beings, two more would be practicing the Martial Tao path.

“Indeed.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

At the same time, he felt quite good.

If nothing unexpected happens, the Ancient Power Supreme Being and Void God Ultimate Being will be the first lives among many paths in the Martial Arts Evolution Road to enter the Twelve-Star level.

The birth of two Twelve-Star beings from the Martial Tao evolution path is also a unique blessing for Lin Yuan, the Ancestor of Martial Arts.

Over the millennium, through spreading via the Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion, more than a thousand paths of the Martial Arts Evolution Road have been inherited in many Void Domains.

However, among all the Martial Tao cultivators, there is still a long way to go to the Twelve-Star level. After all, they do not enjoy the treatment of the nine supreme beings and must continue experimenting with the Martial Tao path they are cultivating.

“Hmm?”

Suddenly, Lin Yuan felt a stir in his heart.

“The clone in the Origin World has entered the Master Realm, and no accident occurred during the process…”

A smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face, “Then I will also directly enter the Master Realm.”

With this thought, the true self, deep in the ‘Shard World’ of the Star Tear, silently disappeared and appeared in the vast chaos of the Infinite Void.

…

Chaos Qi drifted.

Lin Yuan’s figure appeared.

“Entering the Master Realm in the Chaos Void is quite different from entering the Master Realm in the Origin World.” Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, thinking quickly in his heart.

The primary difference is the different inner universe.

Even though both have succeeded in “Infinite Void” at the First Layer, the size of the internal universe of the Source World body will not be as large as the internal universe of the Chaos Void body.

Because the former does not have the Twelve-Star superb wonder like the Chaos Tree to root and bless.

Not to mention, the latter has gone through three Chaos Void Origin Infusions.

Therefore, for breakthrough, the transformation magnitude that the internal universe of the Chaos Void body needs to achieve will exceed the Source World’s body by a significant margin.

“Let’s begin.”

After pondering for a moment, Lin Yuan immediately released the suppression of all aspects of his body, including the universe within the Soul Body.

In an instant.

The first to start evolving was the internal universe.

Boom!

The originally thirty-three million three hundred thirty-three thousand light-years sized inner universe nearly fell into a state of expansion stagnation, but now, as Lin Yuan began to break through, it immediately started expanding crazily again.

“My internal universe, having endured three Chaos Void Origin Infusions, combined with the value of the Chaos Tree, and having practiced “Infinite Void” First Layer, once a breakthrough is made, it will surely require a massive amount of energy support.”

Lin Yuan glanced around, where endless Chaos Qi drifted, although not pure, the internal universe did not mind these aspects, as long as it could absorb and devour.

As Lin Yuan’s internal universe once again plunged into frantic expansion.

It immediately drew the attention of many lives, as Lin Yuan’s internal universe was home to some powerful beings, including dozens of Twelve-Star aliens from the cosmic era.

After completely submitting to Lin Yuan, these Twelve-Star aliens had been staying in the internal universe, awaiting Lin Yuan’s orders.

“The internal universe of the Galaxy Supreme Being is expanding dramatically again?”

“How many times has it been now?”

“Even the legendary Chaos Venerable’s internal universe could hardly have such enormous pressure, right?”

“The power of the Galaxy Supreme Being is terrifying.”

The dozens of Twelve-Star aliens quivered in their hearts, especially since many of them initially wanted to surround and kill the Galaxy Supreme Being.

…

Billions of light-years away.

A silver large ship sped past.

On the bow of the silver ship stood several figures.

“Dear junior brothers and sisters, although the Chaos Void is fraught with danger, you can rest assured with me here. This treasure ship is at the pinnacle of the Master Realm, enough to take you safely to the destination.”

The leader was a man with a black beard, his face showing a self-satisfied expression.

The Chaos Void is indeed full of danger, but that is for the common Path Splitting Realm beings. For him, a Master Realm powerhouse, still with the black treasure ship at the Master Realm pinnacle? Naturally, there is no danger.

“Master, you’re amazing.”

The junior brothers and sisters behind him immediately exclaimed. The silver large ship emitted a heavy aura, giving them a great sense of security.

“But Master, didn’t you notice that the Chaos Qi around has become a bit thin?”

One of the junior brothers couldn’t help but say, compared to the man with black beard, he had been carefully observing the many changes around.

“Chaos Qi has become thin?”

The black-bearded man was slightly stunned and, upon careful inspection, noticed this change as well.

“Why has it become thin?”

Following the position where the Chaos Qi drifted, the black-bearded man vaguely found that all the Chaos Qi seemed to head toward a specific direction.

“What is this?”

The expression of the black-bearded man changed slightly, with his massive perception as a Master Realm being, he vaguely noticed that it wasn’t just this region’s Chaos Qi behaving this way, but the Chaos Qi of the surrounding million light-years and tens of millions of light-years as well.

It seemed as if at the source of all the Chaos Qi, there existed an unprecedented Chaos creature recklessly devouring endless Chaos Qi.

“Oh no.”

The expression of the black-bearded man changed dramatically, and he immediately drove the Galactic large ship to escape frantically in the direction opposite to the Congregation of Chaos Qi.

“Dear junior brothers and sisters, prepare yourselves for possible demise.”

The black-bearded man’s tone was extremely solemn, with a faint trace of despair.

As these words fell, the junior brothers and sisters behind them became somewhat dumbfounded. They looked around and didn’t discover anything.

“Master…”

Their faces turned pale.

Although they didn’t know why the master said this.

But surely it was because of a danger that couldn’t be resisted.

Just where does this danger come from?
